name: Mr. Free Tools

sources.title: Homepage — directory of 'the best free software, apps, and tools'; returns 403 to automated fetch; content confirmed via search index
Description guidelines (search-indexed; page 403s to bots) — required structure: excerpt ≤240 chars starting '{tool name} is a…', plus 80-120-word objective description
Contact page — 'A problem, question, idea, something else? Feel free to reach out' (search-indexed)
Write For Us — free article contribution via Google Doc link, no signup needed (search-indexed)
Launch Point Zero profile — 'Cannot figure out how to submit to this site'; status not_submittable
BacklinkBot entry — claims account creation + free submission with dofollow link (unverified)

conditions: Only tools with a free, freemium, or free-trial tier are eligible — pure paid products are out of scope
No public submission form is discoverable — the route is likely the contact page/email or an account flow; a third-party tracker lists the site as 'not_submittable'
requirements: Tool must offer a free/freemium/free-trial license
Submissions must follow their strict copy format: ≤240-char excerpt starting '{tool name} is a…' and an objective 80-120-word description
Possible account requirement per BacklinkBot's guide (could not be verified)
preparation: A ≤240-char excerpt in their house style ('{tool name} is a…')
Clarity on which free tier the tool offers (free / freemium / free trial)
workflow: Prepare the excerpt and description per the /description/ guidelines
Find the submission route: try the contact page (mrfreetools.com/contact/) or look for an account/submit option on the live site in a real browser — the site 403s bots
Alternatively pitch an article via /write-for-us/ (Google Doc link, no account) and reference the tool editorially
watchFor: Site hard-blocks automated fetches (403 on every page) — all findings are from search-indexed copies
The exact submission mechanism is unconfirmed; Launch Point Zero flagged it as not submittable
Content guidelines are unusually strict — non-conforming copy likely stalls review
Write-for-us is a real free route but produces an article, not a directory listing
countsAsLive: The tool gets a dedicated page on mrfreetools.com appearing in directory search results
unknowns: Where the actual submission form lives (or whether submission is by email only)
Account requirement, review time, link type
Whether the directory is still actively accepting additions
